messages.content:
Return a complete version 2b1 ordered block envelope using the supplied JSON schema. Use text blocks for prose. At most one ui block contains only the requested protocol source and initial integer state entries (empty uses defaults). No fences. No JavaScript, tools, events, HTML or links. One Stack with unique named leaves. Up to 40 leaves, 40 collection members, 64 declarations, depth 32, 16000 UTF-8 source bytes, 10000 frame bytes. Integers for input state. Names start with ASCII letter, then alphanumeric or underscore, at most 48 characters. All declarations must be reachable. Text and labels at most 512 characters. Safe Graphic items use kind plus only required fields: rect(x,y,width,height), circle(cx,cy,r), text(x,y,text), path(d using only M L H V Z, lowercase equivalents, numbers, spaces or commas), group(items of leaves). Numeric coordinates 0..640; viewBox 0 0 450 135.
One assignment per physical line. root = Stack([leafName, otherLeaf]). Each leaf is one named call: Text("text"), Metric("label",numericValue), Control("label",literalMin,literalMax,choices,$variable), Table([{label:"name",score:number}]), Graphic("label",items). Declare $variable = integer and bind it to exactly one Control. Use [] for range or literal string options indexed 0..n-1. Derived name = expression. Strings use double quotes. Numeric + - * /, == > <, condition ? yes : no, arrays, objects, named references, @Sum(numbers), @Sort(rows,"score","desc") are allowed. No unary minus, concatenation, member access, map, interpolation or inline nested components. Produce complete root and definitions.
Choose text for a simple definition. Use a legible diagram if spatial relationships aid understanding. Use controls for a changing decision. Label units, state assumptions, use short readable labels, give each output an informative name and check zero or boundary conditions. Keep geometry inside the viewBox.

Build an interactive weighted comparison of Native Hybrid [9,8,7], Tauri [7,8,8], and Electron [6,4,10]. The three criteria are native experience, lightweight runtime, delivery efficiency. Start with integer weights 40,25,35. Normalize by their sum, rank descending, and show no ranking if all weights are zero. Scores are synthetic.

{"version":"2b1","blocks":[{"type":"ui","source":"// Protocol source for weighted comparison of Native Hybrid, Tauri, and Electron
// Criteria weights: native experience, lightweight runtime, delivery efficiency
// Initial weights: 40, 25, 35
// Scores: Native Hybrid [9,8,7], Tauri [7,8,8], Electron [6,4,10]
// Normalize weights by sum, rank descending, no ranking if all weights zero
$weight_native = 40
$weight_lightweight = 25
$weight_delivery = 35
weights_sum = $weight_native + $weight_lightweight + $weight_delivery
norm_native = weights_sum == 0 ? 0 : $weight_native / weights_sum
norm_lightweight = weights_sum == 0 ? 0 : $weight_lightweight / weights_sum
norm_delivery = weights_sum == 0 ? 0 : $weight_delivery / weights_sum
score_native_hybrid = 9 * norm_native + 8 * norm_lightweight + 7 * norm_delivery
score_tauri = 7 * norm_native + 8 * norm_lightweight + 8 * norm_delivery
score_electron = 6 * norm_native + 4 * norm_lightweight + 10 * norm_delivery
scores = [{name:"Native Hybrid",score:score_native_hybrid},{name:"Tauri",score:score_tauri},{name:"Electron",score:score_electron}]
sorted_scores = weights_sum == 0 ? [] : @Sort(scores,"score","desc")
rankings = weights_sum == 0 ? [] : [
  {rank:1,name:sorted_scores[0].name,score:sorted_scores[0].score},
  {rank:2,name:sorted_scores[1].name,score:sorted_scores[1].score},
  {rank:3,name:sorted_scores[2].name,score:sorted_scores[2].score}
]
","state":[{"name":"weight_native","value":40},{"name":"weight_lightweight","value":25},{"name":"weight_delivery","value":35}]},{"type":"text","text":"Weighted Comparison of Native Hybrid, Tauri, and Electron

This comparison evaluates three platforms using three criteria:
- Native Experience
- Lightweight Runtime
- Delivery Efficiency

Adjust the weights to reflect the importance of each criterion. The weights are normalized to sum to 1, and the platforms are scored accordingly.

Scores for each platform (synthetic):
- Native Hybrid: [9, 8, 7]
- Tauri: [7, 8, 8]
- Electron: [6, 4, 10]

The resulting scores are computed as the weighted sum of criteria scores.

If all weights are zero, no ranking is shown."},{"type":"ui","source":"$weight_native = integer
$weight_lightweight = integer
$weight_delivery = integer
Control("Native Experience Weight",0,100,[],$weight_native)
Control("Lightweight Runtime Weight",0,100,[],$weight_lightweight)
Control("Delivery Efficiency Weight",0,100,[],$weight_delivery)","state":[{"name":"weight_native","value":40},{"name":"weight_lightweight","value":25},{"name":"weight_delivery","value":35}]},{"type":"text","text":"Normalized Weights:
- Native Experience: norm_native
- Lightweight Runtime: norm_lightweight
- Delivery Efficiency: norm_delivery

Scores:
- Native Hybrid: score_native_hybrid
- Tauri: score_tauri
- Electron:
